description: Annual Gas & Electricity demand data for Dublin Emissions Trading System (ETS) industrial buildings as of November 2019 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Rebecca Cachia (Codema - Dublin's Energy Agency). AER Reports.zip Pdfs of individual Dublin buildings each containing energy data from http://epa.ie/licensing/ EPA Reports.xlsx Extracted energy data from AER Reports into a single spreadsheet. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
